schemeContent.detailedDescription_md: The "Ambedkar International Scholarship - SC" scheme by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Government of Rajasthan aims to support meritorious scheduled caste (SC) students in pursuing Ph.D. studies in foreign universities. Under this scheme, financial assistance is provided to SC students enrolled in Ph.D. programs in Humanities and Social Sciences. The scheme is implemented by the Rajasthan Residential Educational Institutions Society (RAJEDU).
schemeContent.benefits_md: **Financial Assistance:** ₹25,00,000/- is granted to selected candidates in three installments: - ₹10,00,000/- in the first year - ₹10,00,000/- in the second year - ₹5,00,000/- in the third year **Scholarship Validity:****** Up to three years.
schemeContent.briefDescription: The "Ambedkar International Scholarship - SC" Scheme by the Rajasthan Social Justice and Empowerment Department provides financial assistance to meritorious SC students for pursuing Ph.D. studies in foreign universities in Humanities and Social Sciences.

children.text: The "Ambedkar International Scholarship - SC" scheme by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Government of Rajasthan aims to support meritorious scheduled caste (SC) students in pursuing Ph.D. studies in foreign universities. Under this scheme, financial assistance is provided to SC students enrolled in Ph.D. programs in Humanities and Social Sciences. The scheme is implemented by the Rajasthan Residential Educational Institutions Society (RAJEDU).
Financial Assistance:
₹25,00,000/- is granted to selected candidates in three installments:
₹10,00,000/- in the first year
₹10,00,000/- in the second year
₹5,00,000/- in the third year
Scholarship Validity:
Up to three years.
Application Process:
Applicants related to the scheme must apply as per the following:
Applicants must apply within one month from the date of advertisement issued by the State Government for the scholarship.
The application form must be accompanied by documents related to age, annual income, caste, and proposed syllabus/subject for the Ph.D. program.
Income certificate must be submitted in the prescribed format issued by the State Government.
The application form for the scholarship should be sent to:  Secretary, Ambedkar Peeth, Mundla, Jamdoli, Jaipur  (Email ID: secretaryapj@gmail.com)

Every year, the student must submit progress reports and details of the research work undertaken to the concerned department. The department will review and record the completed research work accordingly.
State-Level Approval Committee:
From the completely received application forms, a maximum of five applicants will be selected and approved by the State-Level Approval Committee,
Process for Disbursement of Scholarship Funds:
Selected candidates under the scheme will be awarded scholarships for a maximum period of three years.
The candidate must submit a certificate of admission from the educational institution/university where they are pursuing the Ph.D., duly signed by the institution head.
A certificate of attendance from the institution/university where the candidate is pursuing the Ph.D. must be submitted.

Upon approval of the scholarship amount, the Director & Special Secretary, Social Justice & Empowerment Department, Rajasthan, Jaipur will issue the funds either through a cheque or direct bank transfer into the account of the concerned student.

Additionally, from time to time, Director & Special Secretary, Social Justice & Empowerment Department, Rajasthan will receive academic progress reports of the selected Ph.D. students from the respective universities/institutes.

eligibilityCriteria.eligibilityDescription_md: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Rajasthan. 1. The applicant must belong to the Scheduled Caste (SC) category. 1. The applicant must have completed a postgraduate degree from a recognized Indian university with a minimum of 55% marks. 1. The applicant must have secured admission to a Ph.D. program in a foreign university accredited by the respective country's authority. 1. The applicant's age must be below 35 years as of the application deadline. 1. The applicant’s family annual income should not exceed ₹6,00,000/-. 1. The applicant should not be beneficiary of any other govt scholarship program. 1. The Ph.D. program must be in one of the following fields: - Sociology. - Public Administration. - Law. - Economics. - Political Science. - Anthropology.

schemeContent.detailedDescription_md: राजस्थान सरकार के सामाजिक न्याय और अधिकारिता विभाग द्वारा अंबेडकर अंतर्राष्ट्रीय छात्रवृत्ति-एससी योजना का उद्देश्य अनुसूचित जाति (एससी) के मेधावी छात्रों को विदेशी विश्वविद्यालयों में पीएचडी करने में सहायता करना है। इस योजना के तहत मानविकी और सामाजिक विज्ञान में पीएचडी कार्यक्रमों में नामांकित अनुसूचित जाति के छात्रों को वित्तीय सहायता प्रदान की जाती है। इस योजना को राजस्थान आवासीय शैक्षिक संस्थान सोसायटी (राजेदु) द्वारा लागू किया जाता है।
schemeContent.briefDescription: राजस्थान सामाजिक न्याय और अधिकारिता विभाग द्वारा "अम्बेडकर अंतर्राष्ट्रीय छात्रवृत्ति-अनुसूचित जाति" योजना मेधावी अनुसूचित जाति के छात्रों को मानविकी और सामाजिक विज्ञान में विदेशी विश्वविद्यालयों में पीएचडी अध्ययन करने के लिए वित्तीय सहायता प्रदान करती है।

children.text: राजस्थान सरकार के सामाजिक न्याय और अधिकारिता विभाग द्वारा "अंबेडकर अंतर्राष्ट्रीय छात्रवृत्ति-एससी" योजना का उद्देश्य विदेशी विश्वविद्यालयों में पीएचडी की पढ़ाई करने में अनुसूचित जाति (एससी) के मेधावी छात्रों का समर्थन करना है। इस योजना के तहत मानविकी और सामाजिक विज्ञान में पीएचडी कार्यक्रमों में नामांकित अनुसूचित जाति के छात्रों को वित्तीय सहायता प्रदान की जाती है। इस योजना को राजस्थान आवासीय शैक्षिक संस्थान सोसायटी (राजेदु) द्वारा लागू किया जाता है।
आर्थिक मददः
₹ 25,00,000-चयनित उम्मीदवारों को तीन किश्तों में दिया जाता हैः
छात्रवृत्ति की वैधताः
तीन साल तक।
आवेदन प्रक्रियाः
योजना से संबंधित आवेदकों को निम्नलिखित के अनुसार आवेदन करना चाहिएः
आवेदकों को छात्रवृत्ति के लिए राज्य सरकार द्वारा जारी विज्ञापन की तारीख से एक महीने के भीतर आवेदन करना होगा।
आवेदन पत्र के साथ आयु, वार्षिक आय, जाति और पीएचडी कार्यक्रम के लिए प्रस्तावित पाठ्यक्रम/विषय से संबंधित दस्तावेज होने चाहिए।
आय प्रमाण पत्र राज्य सरकार द्वारा जारी निर्धारित प्रारूप में प्रस्तुत किया जाना चाहिए।
छात्रवृत्ति के लिए आवेदन पत्र इस पते पर भेजा जाना चाहिएः सचिव, अंबेडकर पीठ, मुंडला, जामदोली, जयपुर (ईमेल आईडीः secretaryapj@gmail.com)
प्रत्येक वर्ष, छात्र को प्रगति रिपोर्ट और किए गए शोध कार्य का विवरण संबंधित विभाग को प्रस्तुत करना चाहिए। विभाग तदनुसार पूर्ण शोध कार्य की समीक्षा करेगा और उसे दर्ज करेगा।
राज्य स्तरीय अनुमोदन समितिः
पूरी तरह से प्राप्त आवेदन पत्रों में से अधिकतम पांच आवेदकों का चयन किया जाएगा और राज्य स्तरीय अनुमोदन समिति द्वारा अनुमोदित किया जाएगा
छात्रवृत्ति निधि के वितरण की प्रक्रियाः
इस योजना के तहत चयनित उम्मीदवारों को अधिकतम तीन साल की अवधि के लिए छात्रवृत्ति प्रदान की जाएगी।
उम्मीदवार को उस शैक्षणिक संस्थान/विश्वविद्यालय से प्रवेश का प्रमाण पत्र जमा करना होगा जहां वे पीएचडी कर रहे हैं, जिस पर संस्थान के प्रमुख द्वारा विधिवत हस्ताक्षर किए गए हैं।
जिस संस्थान/विश्वविद्यालय से उम्मीदवार पीएचडी कर रहा है, वहां से उपस्थिति का प्रमाण पत्र प्रस्तुत किया जाना चाहिए।
छात्रवृत्ति राशि के अनुमोदन पर, निदेशक और विशेष सचिव, सामाजिक न्याय और अधिकारिता विभाग, राजस्थान, जयपुर संबंधित छात्र के खाते में चेक या सीधे बैंक हस्तांतरण के माध्यम से धन जारी करेंगे।
इसके अतिरिक्त, समय-समय पर निदेशक और विशेष सचिव, सामाजिक न्याय और अधिकारिता विभाग, राजस्थान संबंधित विश्वविद्यालयों/संस्थानों से चयनित पीएचडी छात्रों की शैक्षणिक प्रगति रिपोर्ट प्राप्त करेंगे।

faqs.question: Who is eligible to apply?

children.text: SC students from Rajasthan who have completed a postgraduate degree with at least 55% marks and have secured admission in a Ph.D. program in a foreign university.

faqs.answer_md: SC students from Rajasthan who have completed a postgraduate degree with at least 55% marks and have secured admission in a Ph.D. program in a foreign university.

faqs.question: What is the age limit for this scholarship?

children.text: The applicant must be below 35 years at the time of application.

faqs.answer_md: The applicant must be below 35 years at the time of application.

faqs.question: How do I apply for the scholarship?

children.text: Submit the application form along with the required documents to Ambedkar Peeth, Jaipur or via email at secretaryapj@gmail.com.

faqs.answer_md: Submit the application form along with the required documents to Ambedkar Peeth, Jaipur or via email at secretaryapj@gmail.com.

faqs.question: Can I apply if I am already receiving another scholarship?

children.text: No, the applicant must not be availing any other scholarship.

faqs.answer_md: No, the applicant must not be availing any other scholarship.

faqs.question: Is there any reservation or relaxation for students?

children.text: The scheme is exclusively for SC students, but no additional reservations or relaxations apply.

faqs.answer_md: The scheme is exclusively for SC students, but no additional reservations or relaxations apply.

faqs.question: How long is the scholarship valid?

children.text: The scholarship is valid for three years.

faqs.answer_md: The scholarship is valid for three years.

faqs.question: What happens if I discontinue my Ph.D.?

children.text: The scholarship amount must be returned with 10% interest.

faqs.answer_md: The scholarship amount must be returned with 10% interest.

faqs.question: Who oversees the application process?

children.text: The Scrutiny Committee verifies applications, and the State-Level Approval Committee finalizes the selections.

faqs.answer_md: The Scrutiny Committee verifies applications, and the State-Level Approval Committee finalizes the selections.

faqs.question: Where can I get more information?

children.text: Applicant can contact the Rajasthan Social Justice and Empowerment Department or email secretaryapj@gmail.com.

faqs.answer_md: Applicant can contact the Rajasthan Social Justice and Empowerment Department or email secretaryapj@gmail.com.

faqs.question: कौन आवेदन करने के योग्य है?

faqs.answer_md: SC students from Rajasthan who have completed a postgraduate degree with at least 55% marks and have secured admission in a Ph.D. program in a foreign university.
